name: ather-lanes
description: Ather Lanes: the machine's S2 agent lanes as a board. /lanes shows the decisions waiting for you, the lanes that need a look, and every lane with its slot, branch and PR, from what the S2 lane scripts and git already keep. Read-only; costs nothing while the pane is closed.

scriptsDir.title: Lane scripts folder
scriptsDir.description: The folder holding the S2 lane scripts (lanes.ps1). Empty: the session's own checkout's .agents\skills\s2-agent-lanes\scripts.

machineDir.title: Machine folder
machineDir.description: The lanes' machine folder, passed to lanes.ps1 as -MachineDir. Empty: the lanes folder next to the main checkout, then _machine. Set it only for a scratch proof.
